next.reason: 1985: "The class and other characteristics of the function being referenced are determined by the function definition" (§1985:IV.4.3.8.3.4 GR1). 2023: "If intrinsic-function-name-1 is specified, the temporary data item is an elementary data item whose description and category are specified by the definition of that intrinsic function in Clause 15" (§2023:8.4.3.2.4 GR1). The same requirement for every function 1985 has, the intrinsic functions: the definition of the function fixes the class and description of its result. The 1985 rule refuses no program; the further paragraphs of the 2023 rule say the same of user-defined functions and function pointers (the RETURNING item of the prototype), syntax that other 2023 rules add.
